title: Handle Query Parameters
description: Write a view that reads a 'search' query parameter and returns filtered results.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Create a view `search_posts` that accepts a `q` query parameter (e.g., `/search/?q=django`). It should:
- Retrieve all posts from the database.
- If `q` is provided, filter posts whose title contains the search term (case‑insensitive).
- Return a simple HTML list of matching post titles.

If no `q` is given, return a message "Enter a search term."

Define the URL pattern as `/search/` that maps to this view.
hints: Iterate over the QuerySet and build an HTML list.
Handle the case when the QuerySet is empty by showing "No results".
expectedOutput: When you visit `/search/?q=django`, you see a list of posts whose title contains 'django'. If no posts, see 'No results'. If no q, see 'Enter a search term'.
